mechanism_narrative: The monotone collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES weekly means removes the commuter and workplace-adjacent footfall that retail-and-recreation venues depend on, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks rather than stabilising.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -38.3 to -67.0 across the four weekly means
fact:WORKPLACES fell from -8.9 to -32.3 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than the last-28-day mean of approximately -28.4 while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below their t-1w levels.

mechanism_narrative: Once RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses above +15 percent the population is durably re-anchored at home, and the discretionary out-of-home trips that constitute retail-and-recreation activity are suppressed for at least two further weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean prints at or above +15.0 percent while RETAIL_REC is below -35.0 percent
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from +5.7 to +17.7 over the four weekly means
fact:RETAIL_REC reached -40.0 in the t-0w week
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL is at or above +15.0, the following 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is higher than the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in TRANSIT and PARKS identifies a broad suppression of non-essential out-of-home movement, and their joint deficit depresses retail-and-recreation footfall more than either series alone would predict.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean is below -60.0 and PARKS weekly mean is below -30.0 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -67.0 and PARKS was -35.7 in the t-0w week
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is below -60.0 and PARKS is below -30.0 jointly, the subsequent 14-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Containment policy binds WORKPLACES near -32 percent and lifts RESIDENTIAL above +17 percent; under this policy regime the closure of malls, cinemas and restaurants keeps RETAIL_REC on a declining path for the full four-week horizon.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean is at or above +15.0 and WORKPLACES weekly mean is at or below -30.0
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -32.3 and RESIDENTIAL was +17.7 in the t-0w week
failure_condition: Under the joint condition RESIDENTIAL >= +15.0 and WORKPLACES <= -30.0, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is above the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The turn in GROCERY_PHARM from +3.7 to -8.7 shows households have finished stockpiling and are cutting total trip counts, and lower total trip counts mechanically reduce incidental retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean falls below 0.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from +3.7 to -8.7 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: In the week after GROCERY_PHARM prints two consecutive sub-zero means, RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Monsoon conditions in the Delhi July window drive PARKS deeply negative and push discretionary leisure trips indoors into enclosed retail and recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks on a seasonal basis.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -25.0 during monsoon weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swung from -11.7 to -35.7 between t-1w and t-0w
fact:decision time point is 2021-07-15, mid-monsoon season
failure_condition: When PARKS is below -25.0 in a monsoon week, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC at -40.0 sits roughly 11.6 points below its own four-week mean while RESIDENTIAL growth has flattened, so the marginal household is exhausting the easy trip reductions and retail-and-recreation activity mean-reverts upward over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly mean is at least 10 points below its trailing four-week mean and the weekly change in RESIDENTIAL is less than +3 points
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC four-week mean is about -28.4 versus a t-0w print of -40.0
fact:RESIDENTIAL weekly change from t-1w to t-0w was +2.1 points
failure_condition: After a week in which RETAIL_REC is more than 10 points below its four-week mean, the next-14-day mean of RETAIL_REC is below the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The week-on-week deterioration in TRANSIT has decelerated sharply (about -5 points at t-0w versus about -22 points at t-2w) while WORKPLACES has stopped falling, indicating the stringency shock is peaking and RETAIL_REC recovers over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: Week-on-week change in TRANSIT improves by more than 5 points (i.e. becomes less negative) for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly deltas were -21.7 then -1.6 then -5.4
fact:WORKPLACES moved -0.7 to +0.7 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: When the TRANSIT weekly delta improves by more than 5 points for two consecutive weeks, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is below the last-28-day mean.
